fields.title: Facebook business contact record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one business per row. One BUSINESS row per page, one RUN_SUMMARY per run, ERROR rows when a page cannot be read. A null contact field means the business publishes none, not that the parser missed it. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The page slug this record answers for.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: page_not_found, fetch_failed or unexpected_error.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Why the page could not be read.

pageId.title: Page ID
pageId.description: Numeric page id, decoded from the about section's node id.

primaryCategory.title: Category
primaryCategory.description: The page's first self-declared category, e.g. 'Italian restaurant'.

email.title: Email
email.description: First published email address. Null means the business publishes none - not that it was missed.

emails.title: All emails
emails.description: Every email in the structured contact section.

emailsFromDescription.title: Emails in the description
emailsFromDescription.description: Addresses found in the page's own description text rather than in the contact fields. Kept separate so a declared contact can be told apart from a scraped one.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: First published phone number, in the format the business entered it.

website.title: Website
website.description: First published website, unwrapped from Facebook's l.facebook.com redirect.

hoursLabel.title: Open now?
hoursLabel.description: 'Open now' or 'Closed now'. Facebook does not publish the weekly schedule to logged-out visitors, so this is a status at fetch time, not a set of opening hours.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Follower count. Facebook abbreviates large numbers, so this is approximate and the raw label is kept beside it.

ratingSummaryText.title: Rating
ratingSummaryText.description: Facebook's own line, e.g. '94% recommend (1,236 reviews)'.

recommendPercent.title: Recommend (%)
recommendPercent.description: Parsed from the rating line. Facebook retired star ratings for pages, so this is the rating.

hasEmail.title: Has email
hasEmail.description: Whether the business publishes an email.

hasPhone.title: Has phone
hasPhone.description: Whether the business publishes a phone number.

hasWebsite.title: Has website
hasWebsite.description: Whether the business publishes a website.

hasAddress.title: Has address
hasAddress.description: Whether the business publishes a street address.

contactScore.title: Contact score
contactScore.description: How many of the four channels (email, phone, website, address) the business publishes, 0-4. It ranks a lead list; it does not claim to measure lead quality.

discoveredVia.title: Discovered via
discoveredVia.description: 'input' when you supplied the page, 'ad-library' when the actor found it by keyword.

discoveryQuery.title: Discovery query
discoveryQuery.description: The keyword and country that surfaced this page.

pageCreationDate.title: Page created
pageCreationDate.description: From the page transparency tab, when that option is on. Useful for telling an established business from a week-old one.

isRunningAds.title: Currently advertising
isRunningAds.description: From the page transparency tab. A business already buying ads is a different kind of lead from one that is not.

adStatusText.title: Ad status (as shown)
adStatusText.description: Facebook's own sentence about the page's advertising.

overview.title: Contacts
overview.description: One row per business, ready to work.

qualified.title: Qualified leads
qualified.description: Sort by contact score to put the fully reachable businesses first.
